findings.text: OPEN-3 (S3 region/bucket/CDN, was BLOCKING phase 5): resolved to us-east-1 same-region bucket, private ACL, presigned GetObject URLs (TTL 3600s), no CDN at launch. Same-key overwrite strategy (users/{userId}/profile.{ext}) simplifies replace logic. Phase 5 unblocked.
OPEN-2 (image resizing): resolved to store originals (no server-side resize). Minimal-change default. ResizeService can be inserted in future without API changes.
OPEN-4 (soft vs permanent delete): resolved to permanent delete. DB column NULL + immediate S3 delete. If S3 fails, DB NULL is authoritative; orphan enqueued for async cleanup.

API design: POST /users/{userId}/profile-image (multipart, 200 return {profile_image_url, profile_image_updated_at}), DELETE /users/{userId}/profile-image (204 idempotent), GET /users/{userId}/profile-image (200 or 404). Auth: Bearer JWT + X-CSRF-Token (web). Error codes: 400, 401, 403, 422 (4 validation variants), 502 (2 S3 variants).

Schema: add profile_image_url VARCHAR(2048) NULL and profile_image_updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL to users table. No new indexes, no new tables. Migration additive-only (IF NOT EXISTS guard). Check constraint validates S3 URL pattern.

S3 pattern: users/{userId}/profile.{ext} (private ACL, Block All Public Access enabled). Presigned GetObject URLs (3600s TTL, S3_URL_EXPIRY_SECONDS env var). Same-key overwrite on replace (no orphan for same-extension). Extension changes create orphan handled by OrphanCleanupShell.

New components: ProfileImageController, ProfileImageService, S3Adapter, MagicByteValidator, DimensionValidator, OrphanCleanupShell. Zero existing codegraph nodes affected (impact set empty). DB migration additive-only.

iOS: UIImagePickerController → HEIC to JPEG encode (0.8 quality) → POST multipart. Android: ACTION_GET_CONTENT → Bitmap dimension check → POST multipart. Web: fetch API multipart, drag-drop file processing, progress events via UploadProgress.

Security: magic byte validation (not MIME type), X-CSRF-Token on web, authorization check (caller userId == path userId), private S3 ACL, no directory traversal (S3 key pattern fixed). CJIS scan: no payment/PII data involved; G-10 not triggered.

Performance: 30s server timeout, 1 concurrent upload per user (SELECT FOR UPDATE row lock), 5 MB hard limit at validation. Error handling: validation (422), S3 errors (502), DB errors (500). Retry logic: client exponential backoff, server idempotent DELETE.
NON-BLOCKING (small): OrphanCleanupShell must deploy in same release. If absent, orphaned objects accumulate (storage cost only). Owner: phase 5 software-engineer. Due: same sprint.

ADR-005 (profile-upload-storage) written to .keel/memory/decisions/ADR-005-profile-upload-storage.md. Documents OPEN-2/3/4 resolutions, no contradictions with existing ADRs 1-4 (prior ADRs are CLI/dashboard; no overlap).

decisions: OPEN-3 resolved: S3 us-east-1, same-region, private ACL, presigned URLs (3600s TTL), no CDN at launch.
OPEN-2 resolved: store originals; no server-side resize (minimal-change default, ResizeService insertable in future).
OPEN-4 resolved: permanent delete; DB NULL authoritative; orphan cleanup async.
API design: multipart POST (200 return), idempotent DELETE (204), GET (200/404). Auth: JWT + CSRF (web).
Backend: ProfileImageController, Service, S3Adapter, validators, OrphanCleanupShell. Zero impact on existing codegraph.
Mobile: iOS UIImagePickerController + HEIC→JPEG; Android ACTION_GET_CONTENT + bitmap check.
Web: fetch multipart, drag-drop, progress events. Client-side retry with exponential backoff.
DB: additive-only migration (2 nullable columns, IF NOT EXISTS guard).
